title: Meet a hard feeling (RAIN)
subtitle: Recognize, allow, investigate, nurture — without drowning in it.

steps.body:
RAIN is a way to meet a hard feeling without being swept under by it.

Four gentle steps: Recognize it, Allow it, Investigate it, Nurture what's hurting. We go slow, and you can stop anytime.

steps.title: What's here right now?
steps.body: Just name the feeling, simply. You don't have to explain it.
That's strong. One breath. You don't have to go all the way in — just to the edge.

Allow it to be here.

You don't have to like it, fix it, or make it leave. Just let it exist for a moment, exactly as it is. Even a quiet 'this belongs, for now' is enough.

steps.title: Where do you feel it in your body?
If it could speak, what does it want you to understand?
steps.placeholder: Let it say what it needs you to know…

steps.title: What does this part of you need right now?
steps.body: A word, a gesture, a kindness — offer it, even silently. A hand on your heart counts.

exit.body: You met it with RAIN instead of resistance. That's the practice — not making it disappear, but no longer facing it alone.
